FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 297
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/17/2026
Senate Bill 297 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Public Health by a department estimated: (1) cost of $126,100 (one-time) to
develop software that would allow them to: receive, review, and compile quarterly reports from
all hospitals and freestanding emergency departments in the state regarding physician
availability in their emergency department and publish findings with facility-specific and
aggregate statistics on their website; and (2) cost of $105,000 annually for staff to manage the
reporting and publishing of the data collected.
